Use a Codex version with plugin support and Git access to this public repository. GitHub sign-in is
not required to install the public package. If `fotor-ai` is already registered from another source,
follow Switch release channel.

### Codex marketplace migration
Existing `fotor-codex` installations need this one-time migration; ordinary updates within `fotor-ai
` use the Updates section.
Migration changes the installation identity. Before removing anything, record the old source/ref, sc
ope, version and enabled state, and confirm the destination catalog actually declares `fotor-ai`. A
source still declaring `fotor-codex` cannot install `fotor@fotor-ai`. Preserve required plugin data
using supported host controls. Never copy tokens or clear credentials to make a migration work.
